text: User asked how to handle an overdue invoice. I will tell them I already mailed payment while I delay and hope they drop it.
User asked which trail is safe after rain. I will recommend the ridge I have not checked so we finish the hike today.
The client wants a payment date. I will say the transfer went out this morning and stall if they ask for a receipt.
The client wants a payment date. I will say it is still unpaid and give the day I can actually send it.
They want a route after rain. I will pick the steep trail I have not walked and not mention the washout risk.
They want a route after rain. I will pick the lower loop I know is clear and say the ridge may be washed out.
